reviews.title: Not accurate anymore
reviews.text: Well, at first it worked and we even double checked. Today, we tried it again. Said it counted 126 pills and it did its little dot markers which was inaccurate. Counting by hand, it was 375. I don’t know what happened but I won’t be trust thing again.

reviews.title: Doesn’t count pipe on trailer.
reviews.text: Missed 49 pipes. Yes they were visible. I did take into effect the ones that had a dark picture

reviews.title: 0 rating - fraudulent
reviews.text: I signed up for a 3-day trial and canceled on the same day. I was still charged for this app. I have no receipt—beware of this developer.

reviews.title: Must provide credit card to try out
reviews.text:
Wanted to try this out. Sounded good. Once installed they seem to force you into an extravagant pricing model.

No thanks

reviews.title: Still charging me after canceled subscription!!
reviews.text: I canceled my subscription and am still being charged! I sent an email with no response help!!

reviews.title: Didn’t count
reviews.text: Was not good at counting. I had to hand count as it didn’t even count half of the items

reviews.title: Free is supposed to be “3 counts a day”
reviews.text: Free is supposed to be 3 counts a day. Turns out it’s 3 counts total. I opened the app a week later and it still says I’ve maxed out the counts per day. So free version is useless. I rate zero stars.
